title: Quenched Cheesy Indian Padron Peppers Skewers
description: A sour and cheesy Indian dish featuring padron peppers and ferment-kimchi, perfect for a crowd-pleasing snack. This recipe is raw-friendly and served on a wooden board.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread a padron pepper, a piece of paneer cheese, and a small amount of ferment-kimchi onto each wooden skewer.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the cheese is melted and the peppers are slightly charred.
While the skewers are grilling, mix the lemon juice, garam masala, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Once the skewers are done, brush them with the lemon juice mixture.
Sprinkle the chopped cilantro over the skewers.
Serve the skewers on a wooden board, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
